svg.metadata: Cross-copy photographic reconstruction of Vintage 1991 ISBN 9780679735793. Complete head, title, portrait and author band are rectified together from Etsy photo SHA256 4cca8980e98b2e3a336e110db30bfbb93cd485846ccdcccaeccd7812a7ef4d31. Lower field, Vintage imprint and physical tail are rectified from eBay photo SHA256 2351f0bde9737b565325fd0b1a02942de5917194bca647900c282389fcb4db30. Two-anchor RGB illumination registration [{"gain":1.4380057077649369,"offset":23.609744266351242},{"gain":1.4866266719128585,"offset":12.603574955358482},{"gain":1.9204339947855567,"offset":-63.948708122497536}] matches shared blank field and observed offwhite printing on the lower copy; the upper donor is unchanged; a 50-pixel blend lies entirely below the author band. Orange tabletop contamination in the first four columns is removed with sampled same-photo backing colors; cream glyph pixels remain unchanged. No fonts, generated text or inferred glyph strokes. This SVG is a photographic container, not a vector redraw.
